customers_say: Customers find the water purifier easy to use and appreciate its taste, with one mentioning the ability to adjust it. The installation process is quick, and the water quality is good, with one customer noting a substantial improvement in filtration. However, the reliability and durability receive mixed feedback - while some report no issues, others mention the purifier stopping working and filters breaking within 6 months. Moreover, several customers report continuous leakage from the machine.

reviews.title: Overall good experience so far no issues
reviews.body: Got delivered within 2 days and installed very next day. Till now no problem. Water taste is good

reviews.author: CHANDU
reviews.title: Very Happy with My KENT Purifier
reviews.body: I am very satisfied with my KENT water purifier. The water quality is excellent, and the purifier works efficiently. The design is also good and easy to use. Overall, it is a reliable product and offers good value for money. Highly recommended!
